Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher in anticipation of a kitchen remodel, since the pandemic has caused such a shortage of appliances.
Comments (English): We purchased this dishwasher in anticipation of a kitchen remodel, since the pandemic has caused such a shortage of appliances. Upon delivery, we let the delivery team know when our remodel would be taking place, and were told to call Costco Concierge whenever we were ready and they would come back and install. In the meantime, the dishwasher has remained unopened in our garage during the remodel. Finally, we opened the box last week and discovered that it's missing the power cord for the unit. I called Costco Concierge, both to schedule the install, and to get the missing power cord. In the course of three 1-hour+ phone calls so far, I've been told that it's been too long since the purchase for them to come back and install, and that Whirlpool isn't responding to provide the missing cord--they will keep trying to get a response from them. The first manager I spoke with assured me that he would follow up with me--which he didn't do. This has been going on for over a week, and Costco is content to let me wait to see if Whirlpool responds, that's the best they can do. They won't allow me to return the unit since it's been over 90 days since the purchase, even if it's new in the box. This issue remains unresolved, and I have a new kitchen with a hold where the dishwasher should be, and no resolution in sight. Costco has fallen way short on this one. I can get better customer service from other retailers, and will be purchasing big box items elsewhere in the future.

Sentence (English): We bought our dishwasher a month ago and overall are happy with it.
Comments (English): We bought our dishwasher a month ago and overall are happy with it. We do not like grids on top of the silverware basket - a lot of our silverware have handles are too wide to fit into some of the slots on the grid so we have to hunt for the holes that are big enough to accommodate the handles. I also wish the prongs that hold up the plates would be angled back a bit so that they won't be tempted to fall forward onto their neighbors when the tray is moved - Would be better for cleaning, too, I imagine. Sentence (English): Like everyone the pandemic pushed our new Kitchen install to April of 2023.
Comments (English): Like everyone the pandemic pushed our new Kitchen install to April of 2023. Can't wait to see this Whirlpool 24 in. Stainless steel dishwasher in our new kitchen. Love the smooth design of front of our new Whirlpool. The all plastic gray interior seems solid. The bottom shelf is a stationary design. Glides effortlessly. The soap dispenser offers two options liquid or pill pack. And a separate spot for the dryer rinse aid dispenser. The top shelf offers a removable shelf for taller items. That need more space to wash on the bottom shelf. The control board offers many options. Which includes a Extended Soak Cycle. And an Heavy boost cycle. Other features includes an High temperture wash option and a heated dry option. Looks pretty straight foreward. But always a good idea to read the enclosed manual. Plenty of space for silverware. The inside top rack had the install hardware and handle and a complementary two pack of dishwasher tablets. And a bottle of rinse aid. No electrical power cord. But my contractor will supply this cord with the April installation of our new kitchen. Our old portable has served us well over the years. Which was always a little loud. Whirlpool claims a 55 dBa noise level which should be way more quiet then the old Kenore Portable. In my opinion the Whirlpool brand is a reliable quality option for kitchen and laundry appliances. Check them out at your local Home Depot.

Sentence (English): We got this dishwasher for our cottage.
Comments (English): We got this dishwasher for our cottage. Since it is a new build, a space was left in the cabinets for it and we installed it ourselves. The dishwasher came packaged very well and while installation took a bit of time, it was mainly because we were double-checking everything as we went. The washer easily unpacked, with instructions on the outside of the box and the installation instructions packed inside along with some of the parts. It is important to read and understand all of the instructions before starting because there are a few things you have to buy in order to make the installation. I was very impressed with the way the machine was assembled and how the manufacturer, Whirlpool, made sure it could be easily installed. Most of the work, except for preparing the space was pretty much done. We got a kit with the dishwasher that had all the required installation parts (the hose and adaptor, and the electrical plug, mainly) and everything went together smoothly. The one exception, was the installation of the side clips that hold the washer to the cabinet. We have stone counter tops so the clips had to be installed on the sides of the machine. The instructions say to break off the tabs on the clips, depending on the model, but, the scoring of the tabs didn't make this job easy and I had to do some filing of the part to adapt it to the cabinet. Most of the time was taken up in making sure we got the holes right in the adjacent cabinet, cables and hoses were routed properly, and the washer was level and properly adjusted side to side in the cabinet. If I were doing it again, the whole thing would have taken a little over a half hour. The unit was easy to slide into the cabinet space and easy to handle. One other small problem I had was removing the plastic protective covering on the door (not the protective bag, but the peel-off plastic) which was folded over the door edges and under the inside cover. I had to unscrew the door frame to get at the plastic. If you were having it installed, they would have probably left it on for the owner to take off. The operation of the unit is also pretty straight forward. The only thing you have to watch out for is after you press the start button on top, you have to get the door closed within 3 seconds or the washer will cancel and you have to open the door and restart it. Once you get used to it, it isn't a big deal, though. I like the plastic tub and the unit is very quiet. It will run longer than older dishwashers because the energy saving features require that. Dishes came out clean and looking good. I would recommend this to a friend. It is a nice machine.

Le décompte se fait à chaque fois que le lave vaisselle est lancé. Seul bemol niveau bruit, il est plus bruyant que ce que nous pensions mais rien de dramatique. Nous recommandons l'achat de ce lave vaiselle qui approte un bon rapport qualité prix.

Sentence (English): We purchased this back in 2019, and it has caused us nothing but trouble.
Comments (English): We purchased this back in 2019, and it has caused us nothing but trouble. You press the setting buttons for your desired load of dishes, but then it stops running, and you have to open the door to try a different setting! The silverware lids have all broken off, and you CANNOT put plates in the rear, otherwise, they do NOT get clean. You HONESTLY see the same food stains on the plates after it's run for 3 hours (yes, 3 hours is a normal run time for a load). We've finally put plates up front, and bowls in the back, and things have started to get a little better. But every time the dishwasher gets done, my wife has to pull things out, spray them with our Dawn Power Wash, and let them soak in the sink to get clean. A plumber I know also told us to NEVER use the detergent compartment on the door because sometimes it doesn't open up during the wash cycle (been there, done that! ) He told us to take our detergent pod, and throw it right in the bottom of the machine (we started doing that now.) "Mr. Frustrating" was supposed to make us happy after we got rid of our Frigidaire appliances. I was wrong - reviews tried to make me think differently, but I was wrong and wasted my money on this machine, too. Good luck!

Sentence (English): We have been loyal Kitchenaid kitchen appliance buyers for 15 years (fridge, stove, dishwasher x 2 houses).
Comments (English): We have been loyal Kitchenaid kitchen appliance buyers for 15 years (fridge, stove, dishwasher x 2 houses). We purchased this dishwasher and waited a year to receive it, refusing offers from the store we purchased it from to get us a different brand faster. We received it in September and as of beginning of January it has failed TWICE with leaks. Customer Service is not helpful and they simply outsource the repairs to a 3rd party. The 3rd party technician misdiagnosed the issue (folded door seal), didn't respond to my many requests asking when he was coming back with parts, and it took over 6 weeks to get it fixed. When I called Kitchenaid to find out what was going on and why the technician wasn't telling me when he was coming back I was told there was nothing they could do and I had to keep waiting for the technician who was MIA to call. What? Finally, a Sr. Tech came and fixed it in 5 minutes. 2 months later, the door is leaking again worse than the first time. The insulation inside the door is dripping wet on our hardwood floors and the vent on the inside of the door fell out last night. I now have to wait for another 3rd party technician to come in several days. We wish we would never have bought this dishwasher. Lesson learned - Kitchenaid/Whirlpool is not the company/brand it once was. Quality and customer service are extremely poor and we will never purchase another Kitchenaid appliance again.

Sentence (English): We previously had a Bosch dishwasher for 8 years.
Comments (English): [ Annoying loud noise ] || ---------------- || We previously had a Bosch dishwasher for 8 years. The control board died, so we decided to get a new one. The old dishwasher was super quiet. We didn't hesitate to run it when we were around. The new dishwasher makes a loud CLACK CLACK noise in one mode of operation. I think it's when the upper spray arm is rotating. I had a technician come and look at it and he said it was normal, and I just needed to get used to the noise. It was like fingernails on a blackboard every time we ran it. We returned the dishwasher and got a Kitchen Aid instead.On the plus side, this Bosch dishwasher has better, more adjustable racks than the old one. And it has this great feature where the door automatically opens when it's done so the steam can escape and the dishes finish drying. On the down side, I dislike the controls on the top of the door because I have no idea how long it is until it will finish. And even with the adjustable racks it takes a lot of fiddling to get dishes loaded. The Kitchen Aid that we got instead has wider spacings between the tines, and it's easier to load. The racks seem to be a common complaint for Bosch dishwashers, and we never got used to it with our previous dishwasher or this one.

Sentence (English): A serviceable dishwasher.
Comments (English): A serviceable dishwasher. It cleans the dishes well. It fits beneath the lower ADA compliant counter tops in our kitchen. After two months of use we have had no problems with the dishwasher's operation, so we are hopeful that it will be reliable for the long term. It is not a quiet dishwasher but the noise level is not disturbing. The capacity of the dish racks is a bit smaller than our previous Asco ADA compliant dishwasher, which lasted ten years, but this GE dishwasher does have a stainless steel tub, which is nice. As with most new dishwasher models, the machine does not have any heating coil for drying. This saves on energy, but means we need to leave the door cracked open for an hour or two after it has finished running so that all of the moisture evaporates and the dishes are relatively dry. Controls are along the top edge of the door. Overall, a decent, serviceable dishwasher, which has been reliable so far.

Sentence (English): GE's certified installers are horrible.
Comments (English): GE's certified installers are horrible. I purchased where I did for a 'white glove' delivery. The retailer said GE insists on using their delivery service but assured me it would be wonderful. It was anything but amazing. The delivery person refused to install my dishwasher due to the angle of my cabinet. He never even pulled out the existing dishwasher to see the set up. He lied on the paperwork saying there was a cabinet and a wall impeding the install which was not true- I already had an existing dishwasher in the space. He said the water lines were too short, also not true- I connected them myself and it was just fine. The delivery person never even offered to take it out of the box! I've never had a new dishwasher delivered and I had no idea how much work their was to assemble a dishwasher (manually wire in the power supply with raw wires and wire nuts, remove the thing from a wooden crate that it's bolted into, insulation that goes all in the kick plate and door- it was awful). I am fairly handy, as is my fiancé, and it took us about 4 hours to get everything set up and installed. Absolutely ridiculous and I will never again buy a GE Appliance after this train wreck. I stupidly trusted the GE delivery person thinking they had my best interest in mind - They absolutely did not. Also this all occurred through the Christmas Holiday so this thing sat in my family room all of Christmas until I had time to get it installed a week after Christmas. So inconvenient and such a negative experience. It cleans great, is super quiet and is beautiful but now every time I see it I think of the horrible experience we had. Save yourself the trouble and buy another brand.

The W30 is good except that there is no H-shaped spray arm. Frequency conversion motor, three-layer spray arm, intelligent washing, layered washing and micro-steam washing are all available, which is simply the most cost-effective magic machine. Haier dishwashers use automatic door opening for drying. After washing, they are first dried with residual heat. After the temperature in the cavity drops to 55°C, a gap is automatically opened, and the tableware is quickly dried by using the temperature difference between the inside and outside, with high efficiency and good effect. Why is it 55°C? If the temperature is low, the water vapor will condense into water droplets, which will affect the drying effect. If the temperature is high, it is easy to burn. Another advantage of automatic door drying is that it has a storage function. The w30 can be stored for 3 to 5 days and used as a cupboard temporarily.
Comments (Original): W30是独嵌两用的设计，带顶795mm可以独立摆放，去顶765mm可以嵌入式安装。W30除了没有H型喷淋臂，其他都不错。变频电机，三层喷淋臂，智能洗、分层洗和微蒸汽洗都具备，简直就是性价比的最强神机。海尔洗碗机都使用了自动开门烘干，在洗涤完成后，首先利用余温烘干。在腔内温度降到55℃之后，自动打开一个缝隙，利用内外温差迅速烘干餐具，效率高效果好。为啥是55℃呢？温度低的话，水蒸气就凝结成水珠了，影响烘干效果。温度高的话，容易烫伤。自动开门烘干还有一个好处就是带储存功能，w30就可以可以储存3~5天，临时当一个碗柜使用。

Sentence (English): The previous Siemens dishwasher has been used for 8 years, and suddenly there is no hot water, and the small place cannot be repaired.
Comments (English): The previous Siemens dishwasher has been used for 8 years, and suddenly there is no hot water, and the small place cannot be repaired. This time, I thought about buying a domestic one, but I was very disappointed. Apart from its good looks, it was useless. First, the grid size and spacing There is a problem, the bowls and plates are always placed poorly, and a thick iron wire is enough for the support rail, and it has to be made into double strands, which is superfluous. The second is the chopsticks. The side and the corner, but I don’t know how to design it, so it can only be placed in the middle, which makes it impossible to put other things in the side and back space. One plug board, and another plug board with protection function from Siemens, always washed halfway, and then cut off the power, and then finished washing after pressing the small red dot on the plug board to restore power, the previous dishwasher This problem does not exist. I don’t know why. Four is the most important thing. It costs more than 5,000 yuan. I thought it would be very clean, but the result is really not as good as the Siemens dishwasher. Twice, my son took the bowl and said no, because the bowl There were rice grains on it, which was disappointing. Fifth, I agreed to send an air fryer, but in the end I sent a hot water bottle, and the application for after-sales service has not been resolved until now. After all the above experiences, I was extremely disappointed when I bought a Haier dishwasher this time, and I will not buy Haier products again in the future.
Comments (Original): 之前的西门子洗碗机用了8年，突然没有热水了，小地方没法修，这次想的买个国产的，但是很失望，除了样子好看，其他一无是处，一是网格大小及间距有问题，碗和盘子总是摆不好，而且支架栏一根粗铁丝就行了，非要整成双股的，多此一举，二是放筷子的筒，放在哪里都浪费地方，应该是在最边、最拐角的地方，但是不知道怎么设计的，只能放在偏中间的位置，造成旁边和后面空间没法放其他的东西，三是这几天使用过程中，突然断电，烧了一个插线板，又换了一个西门子带保护功能的插线板，总是洗一半，又断电，按一下插线板上的小红点恢复供电后才洗完，以前的洗碗机就不存在这个问题，不知道什么原因，四是最重要的，花五千多，本以为能洗的很干净，结果真的不如西门子洗碗机，有两次，儿子拿碗说不用，因为碗上还沾着米饭粒，太让人失望了。五是说好的送空气炸锅，结果发过来一个热水壶，申请售后到现在也没有解决，以上种种体会，本次购买海尔洗碗机，失望至极，以后不会再买海尔产品了。

Sentence (English): Compared to our old Ikea (Whirpool) dishwasher, the washing result is overwhelming.
Comments (English): Compared to our old Ikea (Whirpool) dishwasher, the washing result is overwhelming. Finally clean dishes again, clean glasses and even plastic dishes are drying. The machine is pleasantly quiet and also has more space than our old machine. In addition, the practical smart home connection. Actually everything is perfect and it should be 5 stars. But there are still a few small weaknesses that made me deduct a star. Zum Einen wird die Spülmaschine nicht in das eigene Bosch Smart Home System eingebunden, sondern nur über eine separate App und zum Anderen hatten wir bereits nach einer Woche einen Totalabsturz der Maschine, so dass sie nicht mehr nicht mehr bedienbar war. Das finde ich nicht gerade vertrauenserweckend.Als letzten Punkt würde ich mir eine integrierte Verbrauchsmessung wünschen, was sicher kaum Mehrkosten verursachen würde. Bosch hat so etwas ja auch in den smarten Zwischensteckdosen integriert. Die Technik ist also schon vorhanden.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher features are perfect and the washing is well managed as well as the drying even on a short program of 1 hour that we have selected by default.
Comments (English): [ Good but one complaint ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher features are perfect and the washing is well managed as well as the drying even on a short program of 1 hour that we have selected by default. The storage of dishes is facilitated by the modularity of the various adjustable baskets. The only fault that we find fault with the product is its fragile control panel with scratches. But above all because once embedded in furniture with a slightly protruding worktop, you can't see anything. The program logos in dark gray on a black background require you to get on all fours facing the panel to choose the right one. The lighting of the chosen program is then displayed by a line but that is useless. The internal lighting that can be disconnected when the door is opened is also a little useful gadget, unlike a readable control panel. Certainly we rarely use more than 2 programs and we get used to their position. You can also order the dishwasher via the phone! But that's good for geeks.
Comments (Original): [ Bien mais un reproche ] || ---------------- || Les fonctionnalités du lave vaisselle sont parfaites et le lavage est bien géré ainsi que le séchage même sur un programme court de 1h que nous avons sélectionné par défaut.Le rangement de la vaisselle est facilité par la modularite des différents paniers réglables.Le seul défaut que nous reprochons au produit est son panneau de commande fragile aux rayures. Mais surtout du fait qu'un fois encastré dans un mobilier avec un plan de travail légèrement dépassant on ne voit rien. Les logotypes des programmes en gris foncé sur fond noir demande de se mettre à 4 pattes face au panneau pour choisir le bon. L'éclairage du programme choisit s'affiche ensuite par un trait mais ça c'est inutile. L'éclairage interne déconnectable à l'ouverture de la porte est aussi un gadget peu utile contrairement à un panneau de commande lisible. Certes on utilise rarement plus de 2 programmes et on s'habitue à leur position. On peut aussi commander le lave vaiselle via le téléphone !!! Mais ça c'est bon pour les geek.

Sentence (English): Decided to go for a Bosch due to many people online recommending the brand.
Comments (English): [ Quiet and cleans well ] || ---------------- || Decided to go for a Bosch due to many people online recommending the brand. So far I'm happy. It really is quiet and the red floor light during operation is a nice touch.As much as I love smart home stuff, I didn't actually care for the WiFi implementation, but it had it, so I used it. They've actually done a good job here and offer you the ability to download new cycles, or even create personalised ones based on cleaning/temperature/time preferences. The phone notification for when it's finished cleaning is handy too, so you know when to open the dishwasher and let it air out/dry.The lower tray has plenty of wide plate inserts too, something we struggled to find on other dishwashers (our plates have ridges at the edge, rather than tapering like most plates).Installation was easy enough, though I think they need to improve the front door panel fitting system. It seems over engineered and too fiddly.Having the ability to adjust the rear foot from the front is a great addition too. Should be standard on every machine.All in all a great machine, if a tad more expensive than the competition. I paid more hoping it will last longer though. So we shall see.

Sentence (English): I replaced an old 2006 Maytag dishwasher with the Bosch 100 Series in December 2022.
Comments (English): [ Powerful and Quiet ] || ---------------- || I replaced an old 2006 Maytag dishwasher with the Bosch 100 Series in December 2022. Installation was easy. My husband and I did it ourselves. I have been using the dishwasher for a month now and I am really happy with the results. It is super quiet compared to the old Maytag. Our kitchen is off our living room and we no longer have to turn up the TV volume while the dishwasher is running. The dishes come out clean. The drying capability is so-so. Ceramic and glass on the bottom rack dry just fine, but plastics like travel mugs and food storage containers don't dry well. Items on the top rack don't seem to dry as well either. This isn't that important to me though.My only real complaint about this dishwasher is that the tines of the racks are almost too organized and don't easily accommodate oddly shaped items, such as food storage containers. I don't think I am able to fit as much in a load as I did with my old dishwasher.Overall though, I am happy with the performance, quality, and lack of noise from the Bosch 100 Series dishwasher!

Sentence (English): Overall, the machine is good and fits well with our household.
Comments (English): [ Good GE Profile appliance ] || ---------------- || Overall, the machine is good and fits well with our household. It is quiet, and is easy enough to operate. The 3rd rack at the top eliminates the need for the flatware basket in the bottom rack (but it still comes with one and the design has direct jets underneath the basket when in place), which opens up more space for dishes on the bottom rack. The middle rack holds a lot of glassware, smaller items, etc., that you don't want on the bottom rack and includes jets and holders for stemware.While we haven't had this dishwasher very long (about a month due to a delivery delay) there are a few things that we don't particularly like. The bottom rack is too easy to pull completely out of the machine, which is a bit annoying; the controls are on the inside lip of the door - and while this provides a smooth and clean looking profile, its way too easy, easy, easy to hit the buttons by mistake while closing the door, and then the machine proceeds to start its cycle. Then you have to cancel it. I now try to avoid touching the lip when closing.We're trying to figure out why, on the bottom rack, the area designed for large (dinner-size) plates forces you to place them facing one direction, yet the space designated for smaller plates faces the other direction. Just a bit of a difference from our old dishwasher, so just another thing to get used to.By this time in the development of stainless steel finished appliance, I would have assumed that fingerprint resistant finishes were the norm, but they're not. Its the same issue as with our stove and fridge - it should be ubiquitous throughout the industry by now but isn't. So, you're gonna see fingerprints.We have run through all the cycles yet, but overall, we're pleased with the drying mode, with how clean the dishes come out and how quiet it is and how many washing choices we have.

Sentence (English): My previous Maytag dishwasher lasted 24 years.
Comments (English): [ New Dishwasher after 24 years ] || ---------------- || My previous Maytag dishwasher lasted 24 years. I know that appliances are no longer made to the same standards, but after doing some research, I decided to go with Maytag again. I have been using the new dishwasher for about 4 months. What I like: -so quiet compared to my old machine. I cannot believe the noise that I had been enduring for so many years. -the fingerprint resistant finish on the door is amazing. I wish my other stainless steel appliances had this finish. -seems to clean the dishes Room for improvement: -doesn't dry thoroughly. My old dishwasher ended the cycle with hot, dry dishes. This new one only dries the dishes if I am careful to choose the high dry setting. Even worse is I must do this every single time I use it. The setting is not remembered. But although the dishes are mostly dry, the inside of the machine is not. So if I don't empty the dishes immediately, they are sitting in a closed, moist box waiting for mildew to grow. -while I can appreciate the sleek looking design of the front, the controls are tiny and hard to read. Especially since I have to press 3 buttons every time I start a wash cycle. -The door on the soap dispenser is very finicky about staying closed. Maybe I am one of the few people that use powdered dishwashing detergent, but if I am not extremely careful when filling the dispenser, it will not stay closed. Just a few granules of powder make it impossible to get the little plastic door to latch. -my old dishwasher had a spring assist in the door that made it easier to open and close. There may be one in the new model, but it is barely noticeable. I have to put more effort into moving the door. This is especially bothersome when I want to open the door completely flat to roll out the bottom rack. Overall I like this dishwasher, but I don't love it. Unfortunately, I think that this is more about changing expectations of quality over the years, so there isn't much that I can do about it.

Sentence (English): This 1-star rating is due to defective machine, which may be due to mishandling during shipping.
Comments (English): This 1-star rating is due to defective machine, which may be due to mishandling during shipping. Dishwasher arrived with dent (about 3x3 inches) on left rear corner and cracked plastic housing near it on lower left side. Private installers noticed the dent as they prepared to test installation. Water spurted out of the plastic housing the first few tests and machine made odd noise. Then tested ok. Installers were uncomfortable with idea of keeping machine, so I decided to return it. I ran a small load that night. A few days later I ran a second small load which did not complete; error codes indicated that machine would not drain. As I encountered this after several hours, machine had drained. I turned machine on again in attempt to complete cycle and received same error code and this time saw water on bottom. Turned it off and left it to drain, which it eventually did. Costco tech who uninstalled machine saw the cracked housing on side, which I and installers had not.Aside from the defects, I did not like the layout of the shelves in the dishwasher. I found them awkward, not user-friendly. Thus, I ordered a different brand when I reordered. Unfortunately, a month later, I still have not received it.

Sentence (English): I had to replace my old dishwasher which was the victim of a power surge.
Comments (English): I had to replace my old dishwasher which was the victim of a power surge. The tech recommended Bosch to me, and I lucked out and found this model on sale and in stock. The things I liked about this dishwasher over my old one is that it has discrete controls, and an actual on/off switch. Even better, there's a time remaining clock. That clock was handy when I wondered if the machine was running or not, because it was so quiet. It took me a while to get used to the multiple closely spaced rack tines, but a little fiddling around showed me that I could really load all my Fiestaware bowls (6) along one side of the top rack. I was also skeptical about the instructions NOT to rinse the dishes before I put them into the machine, but I decided to see how it would do with dried on eggs and cheese. It cleaned everything nicely. Another feature I also appreciate is the Add Rinse Aid light. It's generally impossible to tell what the level of rinse aid is, so this light is helpful. I just wish I had an idea of how much to put in without an overflow. This dishwasher is easy to use, cleans beautifully, and the black front goes nicely with the other appliances in my kitchen.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher from Bosch is great, our dishes are really clean again.
Comments (English): The dishwasher from Bosch is great, our dishes are really clean again. There are many modes and installation was pretty easy. In the two crockery compartments there is enough space for a two-three person household. The red light that the machine throws indicates whether it is still running or has already finished. Due to the new dry technology, only very little residual water remains in the dishwasher, so there is no unpleasant odor. The only drawback, however, is that you cannot adjust the front of the door (front). The springs on both sides are screwed tight and cannot be changed. The front of the dishwasher closes properly when no dishes are loaded. Otherwise, all in all, a great piece. I would buy it again like this.
Comments (Original): [ Gerät Top! Tolles Preis-Leistungsverhältnis ] || ---------------- || Der Geschirrspüler von Bosch ist super, unser Geschirr wird wieder richtig sauber. Es gibt viele Modi und die Installation war ziemlich einfach.In den beiden Geschirrfächern ist genügend Platz für einen Zwei-Drei Personenhaushalt. Das rote Licht , welches die Maschine wirft, zeigt an, ob sie noch läuft oder bereits fertig ist. Durch die neue Trocken Technologie, bleibt auch nur sehr wenig Restwasser im Spüler, so entsteht auch kein unangenehmer Geruch.Das einzige Manko ist allerdings, dass man die Vorderseite der Tür (Front) nicht einstellen kann. Die Federn an beiden Seiten sind fest geschraubt und können nicht verändert werden. Die Spülmaschinenfront schnellt also ordentlich zu, wenn kein Geschirr geladen ist.Ansonsten aber alles in allem ein tolles Teil. Würde ich so auch erneut kaufen.

We wanted matching appliances to replace our stove microwave and dishwasher and finally settled on this piece. I am really enjoying it! My dishes come out, spotless and completely dry every time. I will say you have to select the right cycles to make this happen, which means you might be waiting several hours for your dishes to finish, but I don't really lead a hectic lifestyle, so this is OK with me, especially to get lime free and spot free glassware and utensils! My single source of irritation is that hand prints really stand out so when you're cooking and your hands aren't completely void of food or grease and you open your dishwasher, you're going to see it. This is definitely not one of the hand print resistant items.

I will put the smaller kids plastic cups up there to make more room on the middle rack for our jumbo mugs.

Sentence (English): I replaced an old 2006 Maytag dishwasher with the Bosch 100 Series in December 2022.
Comments (English): I replaced an old 2006 Maytag dishwasher with the Bosch 100 Series in December 2022. Installation was easy. My husband and I did it ourselves. I have been using the dishwasher for a month now and I am really happy with the results. It is super quiet compared to the old Maytag. Our kitchen is off our living room and we no longer have to turn up the TV volume while the dishwasher is running. The dishes come out clean. The drying capability is so-so. Ceramic and glass on the bottom rack dry just fine, but plastics like travel mugs and food storage containers don't dry well. Items on the top rack don't seem to dry as well either. This isn't that important to me though. My only real complaint about this dishwasher is that the tines of the racks are almost too organized and don't easily accommodate oddly shaped items, such as food storage containers. I don't think I am able to fit as much in a load as I did with my old dishwasher. Overall though, I am happy with the performance, quality, and lack of noise from the Bosch 100 Series dishwasher!

Sentence (English): I've in property management for over 20 years We've install several dishwashers of other brands.
Comments (English): I've in property management for over 20 years We've install several dishwashers of other brands. One thing they all had in common was the 90* brass fitting that screws into the pump at the bottom front on the dishwasher that connects with the copper supply line. We just always remove that. And it always fit into the new dishwasher. Not Kitchen aid. Their connection per their instructions you need a garden hose size female fitting with a 90 * bend to a hose fitting that needs to be clamped to a piece of hose then clamped to the copper supply line, Needless to say ,another trip to the store for this. Not to mention that their design of the drip tray made it very difficult to install. The fitting split the hose a few days later that caused over $25,000 damage to the hardwood floors kitchen cabinets and the level below.

Sentence (English): In the 'pro' column, this Whirlpool model WDP730HAMZ dishwasher cleans all the dishes and cookware well, and it does it more quietly than its predecessor in my home.
Comments (English): In the 'pro' column, this Whirlpool model WDP730HAMZ dishwasher cleans all the dishes and cookware well, and it does it more quietly than its predecessor in my home. The silverware basket is HUGE, and we like that there are some tines that fold down, allowing for the placement of larger pots. The second rack has some vertical adjustment, which allows for bowls to be placed there. Some minor detractions - whereas the pocket (flush) handle is very sleek looking, if you used the handle on your prior dishwasher for a towel bar (like us), you'll need to find another place for that towel. Also, we have yet to find a real use for the third rack. Even with Heat Dry and Extended Dry selected, there is still some water remaining on the inside of the door after each cycle, yet almost all of the dishes are completely dried. We crack the door open and everything is dry within a few minutes. We also have a little trouble seeing the control panel because our countertop projects out 1 3/4 inches from the cabinet face. The tub is plastic, but the inside of the door is stainless steel. The door exterior is also fingerprint resistant stainless, however magnetic, so you can hang your clean-dirty status sign on it. Overall, this dishwasher looks good and operates properly, and at the current price point is a good value.

Sentence (English): After 1.5 years of tormenting myself with a dishwasher that didn't wash the dishes properly, I needed a new one.
Comments (English): After 1.5 years of tormenting myself with a dishwasher that didn't wash the dishes properly, I needed a new one. After a long search and comparison, I came across the Bosch Series 6. The ratings were great, the energy efficiency class very good. Since I already have other Bosch devices and am very satisfied, it was decided. Connection and setup was easy. The programs are extensive and I am totally enthusiastic. I wanted to connect the dishwasher to the WiFi, but that took a while because unfortunately my router is on the floor below. But after a few tries it worked. So once everything is set via the app, it works excellently. When the machine was finished for the first time, I was very excited about the result. I was more than satisfied. Not only were the dishes super clean, but there were no water stains. The cutlery 6nd the glasses shone. The zeolite drying is worthwhile, the plastic containers were also dry and no longer had to be dried by hand. My conclusion: Every euro is worth it here.
Comments (Original): [ Ein hervorragender Geschirrspüler ] || ---------------- || Nachdem ich 1,5 Jahre mit einem Geschirrspüler gequält habe, der das Geschirr nicht richtig sauber gespült hatte, musste ein neuer her. Nach langem Suchen und Vergleichen bin ich auf den Bosch Serie 6 gestoßen.  Die Bewertungen waren super, die Energieeffizienzklasse sehr gut. Da ich schon andere Bosch Geräte habe und sehr zufrieden bin, war es entschieden. Der Anschluss und Aufbau war einfach. Die Programme sind umfangreich und ich bin total begeistert.  Den Geschirrspüler wollte ich mit dem WLAN verbinden, das hat etwas gedauert, weil mein Router leider ein Stockwerk tiefer steht. Es ging dann aber nach einigen Versuchen. Also erst einmal über die App alles eingestellt, das geht hervorragend. Als die Maschine dann das erste mal fertig war, war ich sehr gespannt auf das Ergebnis. Ich war mehr als zufrieden. Das Geschirr war nicht nur super sauber, sondern es waren auch keine Wasserflecken vorhanden. Das Besteck 6nd die Gläser haben geglänzt. Die Zeolith Trocknung lohnt sich, auch die Plastikbehälter waren trocken und mussten nicht mehr von Hand abgetrocknet werden. Mein Fazit: Hier lohnt sich jeder Euro.

Comments (English): [ Auntie Dishwasher is a basic item~ ] || ---------------- || I have been using commercial dishwashers for 20 years, so I knew it was definitely good. I'm greedy, so I'm going to install a 12-person one and then a 6-person one on top of it (I really hope it happens!). I don't need to say anything about how to use it and how good it is at cleaning, so there's almost no noise (it's quiet compared to commercial ones). The only thing is that for the first few days, when the water came out, it would make a splash, so I was surprised when I was next to it because I couldn't get used to it, but now I don't notice it even when I'm next to it. I store the water that comes out in the small container, and I wash the dishcloth and other cleaning products. It's really good. When I first discussed it with the technician, I connected the pipes to number 1, but after he left, I thought about it and moved it to number 2 and cut the length a little more, and it's perfect. The technician worked hard in the heat, so I gave him a cold bottle of cola, and he really liked it~ The staff was very kind and the dishwasher arrived on the promised date, but the drain hose was delayed in shipment and it took 7? 10? days to arrive because of my day off. If the product is good, it's okay if it's a little late. Oh, and I decided to give it to my mother-in-law too. My mother and daughter both have disc stenosis, leg veins, and bad joints, so when I tried it myself, it was so great that I definitely wanted to give it to my mother-in-law. My body hurts, so if I stand for even 5 minutes, my blood circulation is poor and it's seriously uncomfortable. Then the aftereffects last for 3 days. If you order chicken once, you can use the dishwasher as much as you want. Ladies, take care of your bodies. You'll regret it after ruining your body like my mother and daughter. Fighting! Oh, at first I only used the quick wash and then I was curious about the additional rinse, but when I switched to the basic wash, there wasn't much of a time difference and it dried perfectly, so it was better. I could turn it on when I went to work or went to bed and leave the door open, but when I'm at home, I leave it open as much as possible because I think I can use the machine for a long time. And I put a cloth on the top of the lid. A drop or two of water dripped from the lid. It was nothing serious and I didn't have to do anything, but it was annoying. 23/1/7 I'm so happy thanks to the dishwasher aunt. I've tried many detergents that had many good reviews so far and the last one I settled on is LG Natural Pong (powder). I've been using it for over a year. I put less than the recommended amount and run it. Depending on the condition that day, I put a little more on oily days. I kept putting it off because I thought I would install it when I moved, and even after moving, I couldn't find a suitable space, so I kept putting it off, and I was worried about whether it would be a 6-person or a 12-person one, and I kept putting it off again. I'm greedy, so I'm going to install a 12-person one and then a 6-person one on top of it (I really hope it happens!). I don't need to say anything about how to use it and how good it is at cleaning, so there's almost no noise (it's quiet compared to commercial ones). The only thing is that for the first few days, when the water came out, it would make a splash, so I was surprised when I was next to it because I couldn't get used to it, but now I don't notice it even when I'm next to it. I store the water that comes out in the small container, and I wash the dishcloth and other cleaning products. It's really good. When I first discussed it with the technician, I connected the pipes to number 1, but after he left, I thought about it and moved it to number 2 and cut the length a little more, and it's perfect. The technician worked hard in the heat, so I gave him a cold bottle of cola, and he really liked it~ The staff was very kind and the dishwasher arrived on the promised date, but the drain hose was delayed in shipment and it took 7? 10? days to arrive because of my day off. If the product is good, it's okay if it's a little late. Oh, and I decided to give it to my mother-in-law too. My mother and daughter both have disc stenosis, leg veins, and bad joints, so when I tried it myself, it was so great that I definitely wanted to give it to my mother-in-law. My body hurts, so if I stand for even 5 minutes, my blood circulation is poor and it's seriously uncomfortable. Then the aftereffects last for 3 days. If you order chicken once, you can use the dishwasher as much as you want. Ladies, take care of your bodies. You'll regret it after ruining your body like my mother and daughter. Fighting! Oh, at first I only used the quick wash and then I was curious about the additional rinse, but when I switched to the basic wash, there wasn't much of a time difference and it dried perfectly, so it was better. I could turn it on when I went to work or went to bed and leave the door open, but when I'm at home, I leave it open as much as possible because I think I can use the machine for a long time. And I put a cloth on the top of the lid. A drop or two of water dripped from the lid. It was nothing serious and I didn't have to do anything, but it was annoying. 23/1/7 I'm so happy thanks to the dishwasher aunt. I've tried many detergents that had many good reviews so far and the last one I settled on is LG Natural Pong (powder). I've been using it for over a year. I put less than the recommended amount and run it. Depending on the condition that day, I put a little more on oily days. The price of this detergent has gone up, so I'm going to buy a box when it's cheap. But if you stock up on 3 cans, you can use it for a long time, so I don't have to.

Comments (English): I bought this dishwasher as part of package during a sale event (with a LG fridge, which we love). It replaced a 30-year-old Amana. It does not perform as well as my old dishwasher - dishes come out damp (even when using a rinse aid), the tub remains wet when I load it. I also do not like the tone of the warning chimes - it is too high pitched to hear, for those of us with some hearing loss. The front buttons are in the way when I'm using the counter and I turn on the power frequently. Right now, even though it had minor blemishes and looked older, I wish we still had our 30 year old dishwasher. It performed better than the new LG.

Sentence (English): The previous Siemens, which had been used for 8 years, was no longer working, so I replaced it with a new one.
Comments (English): The previous Siemens, which had been used for 8 years, was no longer working, so I replaced it with a new one. Space is limited, so I can only buy this one. Now the packaging is really simple, there is not even a plastic bag, the fuselage is full of dirt, and there is ice in the fuselage, which should be water from the test machine. In addition, the body weight is much lighter than the old model. Fortunately, the appearance is intact. Easy to install yourself. This one has now changed the bowl basket, and the spacing of some grids has become larger, which is more suitable for Chinese bowls. This machine has more intelligent washing, which uses the grating to sense the water quality to customize the washing program, and the washing is generally completed in more than 2 hours. Energy-saving washing is much slower than the old model, it takes 5 hours. In addition, there are drops of water on the back panel of the body after washing. Although it is not a fault, it is not as good as before.
Comments (Original): 上一台用了8年的西门子不好用了，直接换新。空间所限，只能买这款。现在包装实在简单，连个塑料袋都没有，机身全是土，机体内有冰，应该是试机流的水。另外机体自重比旧款轻了许多。好在外观完好。自己安装毫无难度。这款现在对碗篮做了改变，部分格架间距变大，更适合中国放碗。这款机器多了智能洗，用光栅感应水质从而自定洗涤程序，总体上2个多小时洗完。节能洗比旧款慢了好多，要5小时。另外洗涤后机体内背板有水珠，虽然不是故障，但没有以前的好。

Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher - sadly the lack of a star is for AO's details about the product which states that it's depth is 57cm and this is incorrect - it is in fact 60cm. The only reason I spent this amount of money on a dishwasher was because I thought it was the only one that would fit the space - I could have bought any of the significantly less expensive dishwashers that was 60cm. It's a great dishwasher but sticks out as it's depth isn't 57cm and I could have saved myself a lot of money buying a different dishwasher with a depth of 60cm. I even rang AO before it was delivered to check that it was 57cm deep and they said it was. The Miele booklet which came with it states 60cm deep as does the Miele website which I have since checked. I didn't need such a 'fancy' dishwasher and wouldn't have bought this had I known.

Sentence (English): After looking at several models in physical stores, we decided on this one for its value for money.
Comments (English): After looking at several models in physical stores, we decided on this one for its value for money. I have known Samsung quality first-hand for years, and it has my full confidence. We liked its third tray, for cutlery, and above all that it could be removed if more space was needed below. It can be programmed to find the time with the cheapest energy. It also has an eco program, with low water consumption, and a low noise level (you don't know when it's running with the door closed). On a more personal level, we also really liked the line. Consulting "out of curiosity" the price on this platform, we were surprised that it was much cheaper than on other sites, including special offers. Comments (Original): [ Lo mismo, más barato ] || ---------------- || Después de mirar varios modelos en tiendas presenciales, nos decidimos por este por su relación calidad-precio. Se puede programar, para buscar la hora con energía más barata. También tiene un programa eco, con bajo consumo de agua, y un bajo nivel de ruido (no te enteras cuando está funcionando con la puerta cerrada). A nivel más personal, también nos gustó mucho la línea.Consultando 'por curiosidad' el precio en esta plataforma, nos sorprendió que era mucho más barato que en otros sitios, incluidas ofertas especiales. Era tanta la diferencia (casi 100 €), que me escamó.Pero llegó el lavavajillas, con su embalaje original, precintado y sin ningún daño. No hay trampa. Lo dicho, lo mismo, más barato.

Sentence (English): I replaced a 13 y/o Whirlpool with the LG.
Comments (English): I replaced a 13 y/o Whirlpool with the LG. The front membrane panel stopped registering presses, among the issues. The LG has a hard touch sensing control panel that should eliminate the issue in the future. The panel is very legible, lighted and plays a little tune on power up. A small detail that makes it more fun to use. Despite being non heated drying with a fan, the dishes are dryer than the old one. The only thing that ever stays wet are a particular type of coffee cup with a deep indentation on the bottom. Dishes are clean, and the top silverware rack protects knives and other silverware from damage from banging against each other. That also allows removal of the traditional silverware basket, creating a considerably larger available space on the bottom rack. The foldable rack tines create a versatile area to put various items on the two primary racks. Noise level is typical. Barely heard if not in the same room. Hookup was simple with clear instructions. I hooked up the last one and really they're no different in that respect. A drain hose, and feed hose, and 3 wire connections. Took under 30 minutes from start to first test run. The delivery crew were friendly and efficient, and followed my instructions completely. I did have to remind them to give me the hose package I bought. After a few weeks of every other day use, I'm completely happy with this dishwasher. If I could change one thing, it would be the liquid jet dry dispenser. There is no fluid level indicator, and the filling process is slightly awkward. The price was fair, given the post 2020 inflation we all live with now. This was about 50% more than my last machine, but is much more advanced, and it's been a long time since that purchase.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher replaced an existing Bosh integrated appliance, and so installation by AO was relatively simple, as expected.
Comments (English): The dishwasher replaced an existing Bosh integrated appliance, and so installation by AO was relatively simple, as expected. The dishwasher itself is fantastic. It is clean looking with the red lit stainless control panel and runs more quietly than then previous model. Additionally, I was a little wary that this version uses the heat of the wash to dry plates (saving on a heating cycle) but it works fantastically. The machine does have an additional drying cycle if required, but I havent used this at all. Just set it to auto, let the laser inside determine how dirty the water becomes and it either saves water or uses a little more if the wash load is dirty. Great well thought out bit of kit.

It also does a poor job on silverware which always comes out streaked.
